note: Text-only prompt library of the Steamwoven kit (TRD SWI-GEN-3). Each prompt id names a text file; the composed prompt is common.txt + the file with its placeholders filled; its sha256 goes into the provenance record (SWI-GEN-6). No pixels here.

reference_slots.original: the original art of the screen or part, scaled to the master size, given as the image to edit and as the layout truth (original art is a Codex input, owner decision 2026-11-16)
reference_slots.context: the approved context image (whole screen) or a crop of it that shows where the part is used
reference_slots.sheet: the approved material sheet or the swatch of this part's material
reference_slots.plate: the approved button plate that a state overlay belongs to
